summary.headline: Planetary and Meteorological Treatises
summary.text: Continuation of a codex contents list covering questions on the Moon, Mercury, Venus, Sun, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, fixed stars, their motions, the starless sphere, and the four revolving spheres. It also records a Ptolemaic work expounded by Achmet son of Joseph and four books on meteors by Archytas, with a reference to Antonius Elter’s recent study.
